Package resource_manager.loader

Class ResourceIO

  • java.lang.Object
    • resource_manager.loader.ResourceIO
  • public final class ResourceIO
extends java.lang.Object
    A class representing a resource loader.

    Resources are expected to be placed directly into the dedicated resource folder at which point the system can detect files successfully. Files can be placed in a custom folder with custom sub-folders filled with resources however, the top level custom folder must be a direct sub-folder to the project module or folder.
